caption: The drawing depicts a textile layout that features a patchwork of rectangular sections with various designs. The primary colors in the textile are dark navy blue, a salmon-peach tone, and off-white. The leftmost vertical strip has fringed edges and includes a pattern of large, flowing leaves and flowers in salmon on a navy background. Below this, there is a rectangular section containing a salmon-colored depiction of a building with a dark navy roof, doors, and windows, set against the same background. Adjacent to the floral strip is a rectangular section with light and dark areas depicting a bird with outstretched wings surrounded by stylized foliage. The central and right parts of the textile are filled with large ornamental floral motifs, paisley shapes, and a prominent symmetrical medallion-like element. There are also border lines and smaller patterned sections interspersed throughout the design. The overall composition is asymmetric, with each rectangle containing a distinct decorative motif, unified by the palette of navy blue, salmon-peach, and off-white.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
